question: In your research system, the document analysis subagent fetches documents from source URLs before it analyzes them. In one task with twelve sources, some fetches fail with brief timeouts, and two documents return access-denied errors because they require a paid subscription. The document analysis subagent currently retries every failed fetch up to twenty times, so the coordinator waits for minutes on the two access-denied documents. Which changes should you make to the error handling of the document analysis subagent?

options.text: Keep retrying the brief fetch timeouts within the document analysis subagent, because such transient failures often succeed on a later attempt.
options.reason: Subagents should handle transient failures such as brief timeouts locally, so that the coordinator only deals with errors that the subagent cannot resolve.

options.text: Stop retrying the access-denied documents and report them to the coordinator, with the fetch attempts made and the analyses already finished.
options.reason: A subscription barrier cannot be resolved by retrying, so the subagent should propagate it with what was attempted and the partial results, which lets the coordinator choose a recovery.

options.text: Skip the access-denied documents silently and return the finished analyses as a complete result, so that the coordinator has no error to handle.
options.reason: Returning partial results as a full success silently suppresses the error, which the guide names as an anti-pattern because the coordinator cannot react to the gap.

options.text: Terminate the whole research workflow at the first access-denied response, because a missing source makes the final cited report incomplete.
options.reason: Terminating the entire workflow on a single failure is an anti-pattern in the guide; the coordinator should receive the error context and decide how to recover.

options.text: Raise the retry limit for every failed fetch, including the access-denied documents, so that each source gets more attempts before the coordinator is told about it.
options.reason: Local recovery is for transient failures only; more retries on an access-denied document cannot resolve it and delay propagating an error that the subagent cannot fix.
